proves.claim: offerPulledLanding says one line naming a stepped-aside head and its infrastructure-failure count, and nothing for a head with one failure

cli.io-landing-pull.step-aside-says-why.why: Without it the reorder of a stepped-aside head is silent and the person cannot tell why an accepted item landed late.

proves.claim: a head held after a landing red on its own tests is not offered and is not counted as stepped aside

cli.io-landing-pull.own-red-head-stays-h.why: Without it an own-test red could be mistaken for an infrastructure failure and offered again behind the next item.
